sourceTitle: Watermelon, Kiwi, Apple and Frozen Banana Smoothie
sourceText:
Watermelon, Kiwi, Apple and Frozen Banana Smoothie
By: shobelyn
Published: Thursday, September 26, 2013 - 8:35am

Ingredients




1 cup coarsely chopped seeded/seedless watermelon
1 kiwi fruit, peeled and cut into pieces
2 ice cubes
1 ripe banana, frozen and cut into chunks
1/4 cup chilled apple juice

Preparation

1 Place all ingredients in the blender and blend until smooth. Pour mixture into glass and enjoy!

About

This easy to whip recipe is good for you to refresh in the morning. With seasonal ingredients of watermelon, kiwi, banana, you cannot go wrong with this for breakfast to energize you throughout the day.
